title: Affine-open section comparison component
statement: Let f:X→Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and suppose R^p f_*F=0 for every quasi-coherent O_X-module F and p>0 [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For each integer i, the functor on D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] taking E to the restriction of the module presheaf V↦H^i(RΓ(f⁻¹V,E)) [def-pc-derived-section-presheaf] to the full category of affine opens of Y is naturally isomorphic to E↦(V↦Γ(f⁻¹V,H^i(E))) on that same affine-open category. The comparison is O_Y(V)-linear and compatible with every inclusion of affine opens.

proof.text: Fix an affine open V of Y and put U=f^{-1}(V), with v=\Gamma(U,-):\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)\to\mathrm{Ab} and f_V:U\to V the induced morphism, again quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let F be a quasi-coherent O_X-module; then F|_U is quasi-coherent. By [lem-sc-ringed-space-restrict-injective-resolution] an injective resolution F\to I^\bullet restricts to an injective resolution of F|_U, so R^p v(F)=H^p(U,F|_U), and by [lem-pc-restrict-derived-direct-image-open] applied to F[0] we have (R^pf_*F)|_V\cong R^p(f_V)_*(F|_U); the hypothesis therefore gives R^p(f_V)_*(F|_U)=0 for p>0. The higher direct images R^q(f_V)_*(F|_U) are quasi-coherent by [lem-pc-finite-support-hi], and V is affine, so H^p(V,R^q(f_V)_*(F|_U))=0 for p>0 by [lem-pc-affine-vanishing]. The Leray degeneration statement [lem-pc-leray-degenerate-sections] (2) for f_V then identifies H^p(U,F|_U) with \Gamma(V,R^p(f_V)_*(F|_U))=0 for p>0, so R^p v(F)=0 for p>0 and every quasi-coherent F. Finally v commutes with countable products by the product universal property (a map into a product is exactly a family of maps into its factors).

proof.text: For any integer i, shift E so that it suffices to prove the assertion in degree 0. Apply the cohomological-bound statement [lem-pc-unbounded-derived-functor-cohomological-bound] to v with N=1 and the truncation \tau_{\le -1}E: its cohomology vanishes above -1, hence H^j(Rv(\tau_{\le -1}E))=0 for every j\ge0. The triangle \tau_{\le -1}E\to E\to\tau_{\ge0}E\to therefore gives a natural isomorphism H^0(RvE)\cong H^0(Rv\tau_{\ge0}E).

source.place: Tag 08D4, part (3), applied to the standard truncation triangle

proof.text: The bounded-below complex \tau_{\ge0}E has quasi-coherent cohomology, and every positive derived functor R^p v on those cohomology sheaves vanishes by Step 1. Apply the truncation hypercohomology spectral sequence [thm-sp-truncation-e2] to v and \tau_{\ge0}E. Its E_2-page is E_2^{p,q}=R^p v(H^q(E)); all entries with p>0 are zero, so the finite filtration in its abutment has only the p=0 graded piece. Consequently H^0(Rv\tau_{\ge0}E)\cong v(H^0(E)) naturally in E. Undoing the shift gives H^i(R\Gamma(U,E))\cong\Gamma(U,H^i(E)). The construction is natural in E and restriction-compatible because all truncation, spectral-sequence, and section maps are functorial.

proof.text: The resolution and spectral-sequence edge comparisons are natural in the derived object, commute with restriction of affine opens and scalar multiplication, and thus assemble into a natural isomorphism of module presheaves on the full affine-open category.

theorem qcoh_acyclic_derived_sections_comparison_sections {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (hacyc : ∀ (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)),
      F.IsQuasicoherent → ∀ (p : ℤ), 0 < p →
        IsZero ((schemeModuleHigherDirectImage f p).obj F))
    (i : ℤ) :
    Nonempty
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedSectionPresheaf f i ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀
            (ObjectProperty.ι (fun V : Y.Opens ↦ IsAffineOpen V))
            (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).obj ≅
        (schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙
          DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i ⋙
          RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom ⋙
          SheafOfModules.forget (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace) ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀
            (ObjectProperty.ι (fun V : Y.Opens ↦ IsAffineOpen V))
            (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).obj)
